title: Olympe de Gouges
summary: Olympe de Gouges, born Marie Gouze at or near Montauban in 1748, was a butcher's daughter who became a Paris playwright and political writer. Her anti-slavery play was performed by the Comédie Française in 1789, and in 1791 she published a Declaration of the Rights of Woman to parallel the men's declaration. She was executed in Paris on 3 November 1793 for crimes against the state.
